name: Takayuki's and Haruka's Daughter
source: The daughter of Narumi Takayuki and Suzumiya Haruka in the Akane Pregnancy Ending. She considers Akane as her own "mother", while Haruka the biological mother as an "aunt". As an illegitimate child, she has Suzumiya surname.
